title: Inner product of graph points
statement: For all natural numbers n, l, all x, x' in R^n and all y, y' in R^l: <graphPoint x y, graphPoint x' y'> = <x, x'> + <y, y'>, where < , > is the real inner product of the Euclidean spaces R^k = EuclideanSpace R (Fin k) and graphPoint x y in R^(n+l) = Amb n l has first n coordinates x and last l coordinates y.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (x x' : Rn n) (y y' : Rn ℓ), inner ℝ (graphPoint x y) (graphPoint x' y') = inner ℝ x x' + inner ℝ y y'
